name: OneWorks Avatar
summary: Browser editor that builds, animates and exports geometric 3D avatars as SVG, PNG or GIF, with React/Vue components and an agent skill.
description: Browser-based 3D geometric avatar editor: pick a built-in avatar or build one, adjust pose, position, scale, face, materials, lighting, shadows, stroke and animation, then copy SVG or download SVG, PNG or animated GIF at 128, 256 or 512 px. The repository also ships framework packages — @oneworks/avatar core runtime, @oneworks/avatar-react, @oneworks/avatar-vue and @oneworks/avatar-web — plus the oneworks-avatar Agent Skill that drives the real editor and its 3D scene model.
contains: browser-based 3D geometric avatar editor at oneworks.cloud/avatar
exports SVG, PNG and animated GIF at 128, 256 or 512 px, with transparent background option
customize pose, position, scale, face, materials, lighting, shadows, stroke and animation
oneworks-avatar Agent Skill drives the real editor's 3D scene model
